_doc: Emerald-only story objects of the post-game (emerald_ch12_13, 2026-10-12; format: b2tools/patches/story.py; rooms' tiles = pokeemerald's, every room's origin (0,0); Emerald-only rooms by "zone" (data/emerald/hoenn_interiors.json), triggers with their floor's "y" (story.cave_y on the built cave)). Steven in Meteor Falls' Steven's Cave (pokeemerald MeteorFalls_StevensCave object 1; src/field_scripts/emerald/0754_room_MeteorFalls_StevensCave.s script 2), Groudon at the end of Terra Cave and Kyogre at the end of Marine Cave (pokeemerald TerraCave_End / MarineCave_End object 1, Black 2's legendary models; shown by their zone inits while not caught or beaten) and their step triggers (pokeemerald's coord events, VAR_TEMP_1 = the zone-local work 0x4001; script 2 of 0732 / 0738). The Fossil Maniac's warning in Route 114's tunnel after the game (pokeemerald's two coord events; script 3 of src/field_scripts/emerald/1116_room_Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel.s). The Safari Zone expansion's construction workers (closing the way into the new areas until the Hall of Fame) and its attendant (after it): global scripts 2296 / 2297 (src/field_scripts/emerald/1236_global_2280.s).

objects.what: MeteorFalls_StevensCave: Steven (pokeemerald OBJ_EVENT_GFX_STEVEN, FACE_UP; Emerald's post-game boss, TRAINER_STEVEN_EMERALD)
TerraCave_End: Groudon comes down to you (pokeemerald TerraCave_End coord event, VAR_TEMP_1 1)
MarineCave_End: Kyogre comes down to you (pokeemerald MarineCave_End coord event, VAR_TEMP_1 1)
the Fossil Maniac's warning about the Desert Underpass (pokeemerald coord events (5,4) (6,4), VAR_FOSSIL_MANIAC_STATE 1)
construction worker 1 (pokeemerald SafariZone_South object 5, CAMPER, FACE_LEFT): the way east closed until the game is clear
construction worker 2 (pokeemerald SafariZone_South object 6, CAMPER, FACE_LEFT)
the expansion's attendant (pokeemerald SafariZone_Southeast object 5, CAMPER, FACE_DOWN): there after the game
